analysis.certificate_dominance: nonempty exact covered-request superset and total all-attempt cost ratio at most19/20
analysis.deterministic_controls: one execution per population; repeated seed slots are algebraic weights only
analysis.missing: retain scheduled denominator and all measured costs; withhold full-denominator positive ranking
analysis.ordinary_catalogue: mean whole fixed configurations before taking a descriptive minimum
analysis.ties: retain all exact equalities; no arbitrary winner

broker.configuration_selection: Whole configurations fixed ex ante. Mirrors are mandatory identity duplicates, not independent observations. No per-seed or per-query best-method oracle.

cost_scope.adapter_source_bytes: This co-located adapter file is installed in full and equally for every method.
cost_scope.excluded_execution: Population supplier, Python orchestration/import/JSON audit encoding, private scoring and analysis; not a physical CPU or process-memory tariff.
cost_scope.optional_reporting: Separate paid source and execution account; excluded from terminal-only economic comparisons.

broker.population_scope: Two fixed prospective recipe instances per family; no IID population claim.
broker.preparation: No offline fitting, alignment, representation search or truth prepopulation; every episode starts at equal six-expert weights and empty scientific caches.
broker.randomness_scope: Prespecified finite DEVELOPMENT_MT seed paths; no empirical fair-bit or coverage claim.
broker.receiving_service: Immutable pre-current-computation forecast and terminal binary action, knowledge status, retained paid word record; unresolved proof attempts retain named fallback.

recipes.cheap_null: Equal counts of empty CNF, an empty clause, opposing units, and a complete consistent unit assignment, with bounded public variable counts/signs and a shuffled order. Visible exact shortcuts remain available to every method.
recipes.gate_duplicate_rule: At most64 public canonical-key redraws per gate position, without truth calls. Exhaustion is a preserved generation failure, not a new population attempt.
recipes.gate_transfer: 64 mixed-prefix requests, followed by64 unique width≤3 gate-CNF circuit-miter requests. Three primary inputs, two four-gate AND/OR/XOR circuits, final XOR miter asserted true; twelve total variables. Second circuit is copied, one-gate-mutated, or independently drawn with equal generator probability. Gate descriptions/construction modes are not delivered to policies. Fixed implementation and paid online state continue across the boundary.
recipes.mixed: Frozen P3-08-style width/density/component mixture on4/6/8/10/12 variables; every eighth request repeats the formula seven positions earlier, under a new opaque query ID.

lifecycle.completion_authority: immutable unit seals binding exact result bytes and source/config/input hashes
lifecycle.deterministic_defect: versioned amendment; preserve freeze, exposure and every attempted output
lifecycle.post_exposure_amendment: affected exposed data loses original confirmatory status; no hidden replacement cohort
lifecycle.retry: unchanged binding and fixed paths; verify and preserve completed units
lifecycle.unit_boundaries: one public recipe; one complete stateful method episode/history; one private score per method unit; one aggregate analysis
